title: Undiscovered
full_review:
"Undiscovered" (Lions Gate) is a contrived romance about a love-shy model, Brier (Pell James), who -- to pursue a career in acting -- relocates from New York to Los Angeles.

Once in La-La Land she meets Luke (Steven Strait), an aspiring singer-songwriter with whom she had a fleeting love-at-first-sight flirtation back East. Brier tries to jump-start Luke's career by spreading buzz about him and having her agent (Carrie Fisher) call in favors to get him mentioned in the gossip columns. She even hires gorgeous women to throw themselves at him like groupies.

But Luke only has eyes for Brier, who -- having sworn off dating musicians -- struggles to resist the pull of their attraction.

Despite an unvarnished "indie" look and appealing young cast (which includes Kip Pardue and Ashlee Simpson), director Meiert Avis' middling meditation on love and fame is weighed down by its predictable, cliche-laden script.

The film has an implied sexual encounter as well as some sexually suggestive situations, brief drug content and scattered crude language. The USCCB Office for Film & Broadcasting classification is A-III -- adults. The Motion Picture Association of America rating is PG-13 -- parents are strongly cautioned. Some material may be inappropriate for children under 13.
